$readme: ACTUAL state of branch protection on main, read back from GitHub on 2026-10-18 with:
Protection is a repository RULESET ('main — protected', id 25297401), not the legacy
branch-protection API: the repo is user-owned and PUT /branches/main/protection is rejected
for user-owned repositories. This file records reality; it is not a PUT payload. To change
protection, edit the ruleset (gh api -X PUT repos/tanviruchahs2580/AgroBridge/rulesets/25297401)
and then re-capture this file. Keys beginning with '$' and 'deliberate_deviations' are
name: main — protected

deliberate_deviations.rationale: Solo maintainer: GitHub does not allow approving your own PR, so a 1-approval rule would deadlock every change; raise to 1 in the commit that adds a second maintainer.
CODEOWNERS names the same single maintainer, so requiring code-owner review would block the only person who may merge; enable it when a second reviewer exists.
With one active contributor plus Dependabot churn, up-to-date-before-merge adds rebase round-trips; the 11 required contexts still gate the exact SHA that lands on main.
